Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​
movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movies.tagline: The eye of the enemy is moving.

movies.overview: Returning by train to the French port of Le Havre, Jacques Lantier, a tormented railwayman, meets by chance the impulsive stationmaster Roubard and Séverine, his wife.
movies.title: La Bête Humaine

movies.overview: A man takes a job at an asylum with hopes of freeing his imprisoned wife.
movies.title: A Page of Madness

movies.overview: Traveling businessman David Mann angers the driver of a rusty tanker while crossing the California desert. A simple trip turns deadly, as Mann struggles to stay on the road while the tanker plays cat and mouse with his life.
movies.title: Duel
movies.tagline: The most bizarre murder weapon ever used!

movies.overview: A prominent politician is murdered during a demonstration. The government and army are trying to suppress the truth. But, a tenacious magistrate is determined to not to let them get away with it.
movies.title: Z
movies.tagline: He is alive!

movies.overview: A gambler discovers an old flame while in Argentina, but she's married to his new boss.
movies.title: Gilda
movies.tagline: There NEVER was a woman like Gilda!

movies.original_title: Beyond the Valley of the Dolls
movies.overview: An all-girl rock band moves to Hollywood in the hope of achieving success, only to fall into a whirlpool of wickedness and decadence.
movies.title: Beyond the Valley of the Dolls
movies.tagline: This Is Not A Sequel. There Has Never Been Anything Like It!

movies.overview: Five high school students from different walks of life endure a Saturday detention under a power-hungry principal. The disparate group includes rebel John, princess Claire, outcast Allison, brainy Brian and Andrew, the jock. Each has a chance to tell his or her story, making the others see them a little differently -- and when the day ends, they question whether school will ever be the same.
movies.title: The Breakfast Club
movies.tagline: They only met once, but it changed their lives forever.

movies.overview: After discovering the dead body of her teenage daughter's lover, a housewife takes desperate measures to protect her family from scandal.
movies.title: The Reckless Moment
movies.tagline: It could happen to so many married women!

movies.overview: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization.
movies.title: Avatar
movies.tagline: Enter the world of Pandora.

movies.overview: The rebellious Thracian Spartacus, born and raised a slave, is sold to Gladiator trainer Batiatus. After weeks of being trained to kill for the arena, Spartacus turns on his owners and leads the other slaves in rebellion. As the rebels move from town to town, their numbers swell as escaped slaves join their ranks. Under the leadership of Spartacus, they make their way to southern Italy, where they will cross the sea and return to their homes.
movies.title: Spartacus
movies.tagline: They trained him to kill for their pleasure ... but they trained him a little too well

movies.overview: Four prison inmates have been hatching a plan to literally dig out of jail when another prisoner, Claude Gaspard, is moved into their cell. They take a risk and share their plan with the newcomer. Over the course of three days, the prisoners and friends break through the concrete floor using a bed post and begin to make their way through the sewer system – yet their escape is anything but assured.
movies.title: Le Trou
movies.tagline: Poor Gaspard...

movies.overview: The Black Audio Film Collective’s acclaimed essay film, 'Handsworth Songs', examines the 1985 race riots in Handsworth and London. Interweaving archival photographs, newsreel clips, and home movie footage, the film is both an exploration of documentary aesthetics and a broad meditation social and cultural oppression through Britain’s intertwined narratives of racism and economic decline.
movies.title: Handsworth Songs

movies.overview: Free after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. An encounter with shifty gangster Benny Blanco sets the duo on a dangerous path.
movies.title: Carlito's Way
movies.tagline: He's got a good future if he can live past next week.

movies.overview: The buttoned-down, superstitious Kay is attempting to lead a normal existence with her new boyfriend Louis. That’s until Sweetie, her rampaging, devil-may-care sister, returns home after an absence, exposing the rotten roots of their family and placing a strain on Kay and Louis’ relationship.
movies.title: Sweetie
movies.tagline: There will not be a more extraordinary film than “Sweetie” in a long long time!

movies.overview: Jean-Luc Godard mixes video and film in his Grenoble studio, discussing how he secured funding for the film. The action unfolds on two monitors, as a young working-class couple lives in a claustrophobic, high-rise apartment complex and marital discord is set off by the wife’s infidelity.
movies.title: Numéro deux
movies.tagline: It's my body, it's my kitchen, my kids. It's too much, and yet, it's not enough.

movies.overview: After his family is slain by the notorious bandit Gabbar Singh, former Inspector Thakur Baldev Singh enlists low-level outlaws Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar and seek revenge.
movies.title: Sholay
movies.tagline: The greatest cast ever assembled! The greatest story ever told!

movies.overview: A teenage girl is captured by a giant mutated squid-like creature that appears from Seoul's Han River after toxic waste was dumped in it, prompting her family into a frantic search for her.
movies.title: The Host
movies.tagline: Man has made his newest predator.

movies.overview: A day in the city of Berlin, which experienced an industrial boom in the 1920s, and still provides an insight into the living and working conditions at that time. Germany had just recovered a little from the worst consequences of the First World War, the great economic crisis was still a few years away and Hitler was not yet an issue at the time.
movies.title: Berlin: Symphony of a Great City

movies.overview: Roberto, a shy law student in Rome, meets Bruno, a forty-year-old exuberant, capricious man, who takes him for a drive through the Roman and Tuscany countries in the summer. When their journey starts to blend into their daily lives though, the pair’s newfound friendship is tested.
movies.title: Il Sorpasso

movies.overview: The mostly true story of the legendary "worst director of all time", who, with the help of his strange friends, filmed countless B-movies without ever becoming famous or successful.
movies.title: Ed Wood
movies.tagline: Movies were his passion. Women were his inspiration. Angora sweaters were his weakness.

movies.original_title: Il fiore delle Mille e una notte
movies.overview: The final part of Pasolini's Trilogy of Life series is rich with exotic tales of slaves and kings, potions, betrayals, demons and, most of all, love and lovemaking in all its myriad forms. Mysterious and liberating, this is an exquisitely dreamlike and adult interpretation of the original folk tales.
movies.title: Arabian Nights
movies.tagline: Pier Paolo Pasolini unfolds the Sensual and Erotic tales of the fabled... 1001 Arabian Nights

movies.overview: A young Anatolian Greek, entrusted with his family's fortune, loses it en route to Istanbul and dreams of going to America.
movies.title: America America
movies.tagline: One man's struggle to the golden shore

movies.overview: In the midst of trying to legitimize his business dealings in 1979 New York and Italy, aging mafia don, Michael Corleone seeks forgiveness for his sins while taking a young protege under his wing.
movies.title: The Godfather Part III
movies.tagline: All the power on earth can't change destiny.

movies.overview: On the run and in search of help, two wounded gangsters find refuge in the secluded castle of a feeble man and his wife; however, under the point of a gun, nothing is what it seems.
movies.title: Cul-de-sac
movies.tagline: Sometimes there’s nothing left to do but laugh!

movies.overview: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden, but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup.
movies.title: Kwaidan
movies.tagline: In the tradition of "RASHOMON" and "GATE OF HELL."

movies.overview: A hard-working mother inches towards disaster as she divorces her husband and starts a successful restaurant business to support her spoiled daughter.
movies.title: Mildred Pierce
movies.tagline: Please don't tell anyone what Mildred Pierce did!

movies.overview: A former prostitute works to create a new life for herself in a small town, but a shocking discovery could threaten everything.
movies.title: The Naked Kiss
movies.tagline: Shock and Shame Story of a Night Girl!

movies.overview: Two Navy men are ordered to bring a young offender to prison, but decide to show him one last good time along the way.
movies.title: The Last Detail
movies.tagline: No *#@!!* Navy’s going to give some poor **!!@* kid eight years in the #@!* brig without me taking him out for the time of his *#@!!* life.

movies.overview: A society woman believes her husband is having an affair, a misconception which may have dire personal consequences for all involved.
movies.title: Lady Windermere's Fan
